say:1:1524606001:0.text: Master <style="stress"><player_name></style>! Have you got to the bottom of their dispute?

narration:2:1524606002:1.text: You hand the herb over to Gala and tell Gala the ins and outs of the matter.

say:3:1524606003:1.text: The warriors always leave important things lying around... I'll make sure to set them straight.

say:3:1524606003:1.female: The warriors always leave important things lying around... I'll make sure to set them straight.

say:4:1524606004:1.text: Thanks for bringing back the herb.
say:4:1524606004:1.source_cn: 谢谢您帮我带回这些药草。
